description: Reusable skill challenge templates for contextual gameplay
note: Updated for new 13-skill system: removed Medicine, Animal Handling, Survival, History, Nature, Religion, Insight, Persuasion, Intimidation, Performance, Stealth. Added Endurance, Academia, Cunning, Creativity, Empathy, Influence.

challengeTemplates.name: Trap Detection & Disarm
challengeTemplates.description: Spot and disable a dangerous trap

stages.description: Notice the trap before triggering it

onSuccess.message: You spot the trap mechanism!

onFailure.message: You trigger the trap!

onSuccess.message: You successfully disarm the trap!

onFailure.message: You fumble with the mechanism and trigger the trap!

challengeTemplates.name: Locked Door
challengeTemplates.description: A locked door bars your way

onSuccess.message: You pick the lock and the door swings open.

onFailure.message: You break your lockpick. The lock remains intact.

onSuccess.message: You smash the door open with brute force!

onFailure.message: You hurt your shoulder trying to break down the door.

onSuccess.message: You identify a magical seal and dispel it!

onFailure.message: The magical seal resists your attempts.

options.description: Threaten or persuade the bandits to leave

onSuccess.message: The bandits are convinced by your words and flee!

onFailure.message: The bandits reject your words and attack!

options.description: Trick the bandits with false information

onSuccess.message: The bandits believe your lie about approaching guards and flee!

onFailure.message: The bandits see through your deception and attack!

onSuccess.message: You connect with the bandits emotionally. They agree to leave peacefully!

onFailure.message: Your emotional appeal falls flat and they attack!

onSuccess.message: You identify handholds and a safe path.

onFailure.message: You begin climbing without a clear plan.

onSuccess.message: You reach the top safely!

onFailure.message: You slip and fall!

onSuccess.message: You find signs of a hidden compartment!

onFailure.message: You find nothing of interest.

onSuccess.message: You retrieve the hidden treasure!

onFailure.message: The compartment is stuck. You cannot open it.

challengeTemplates.name: Calm Wild Beast
challengeTemplates.description: Attempt to calm an aggressive wild animal

onSuccess.message: You connect with the animal. It calms down and leaves peacefully.

onFailure.message: The animal remains hostile and attacks!

challengeTemplates.name: Sneak Past Guards
challengeTemplates.description: Move silently and stay hidden past enemy guards

onSuccess.message: You slip past the guards unnoticed.

onFailure.message: You make a noise and a guard spots you!

options.description: Hide in the shadows and wait for an opening

onSuccess.message: You blend into the shadows and slip past when they're not looking.

onFailure.message: A guard spots you hiding!

challengeTemplates.name: Arcane Puzzle
challengeTemplates.description: Solve a magical puzzle to unlock a door

options.description: Use magical knowledge to solve the puzzle

onSuccess.message: You understand the magical principles and solve the puzzle!

onFailure.message: The puzzle remains unsolved.

onSuccess.message: Through careful observation, you solve the puzzle!

onFailure.message: The puzzle is too complex to understand.

options.description: Think outside the box to find an unconventional solution

onSuccess.message: Your creative approach reveals a hidden solution!

onFailure.message: Your unconventional approach doesn't work.

challengeTemplates.name: Decipher Ancient Text
challengeTemplates.description: Read an ancient inscription or tome

onSuccess.message: You translate the ancient text and gain valuable information!

onFailure.message: The text is too damaged or complex to understand.

challengeTemplates.name: Stabilize Wounded NPC
challengeTemplates.description: Provide aid to a critically wounded person

onSuccess.message: You stabilize the wounded person using your medical knowledge!

onFailure.message: Despite your efforts, the person's condition worsens.

options.description: Examine the wounds and apply practical first aid

onSuccess.message: You identify the injury and treat it effectively!

onFailure.message: You cannot determine how to help them.

challengeTemplates.name: Track Creature
challengeTemplates.description: Follow tracks to find a creature

onSuccess.message: You discover fresh tracks!

onFailure.message: You cannot find any tracks in this area.

stages.description: Follow the tracks to the creature

onSuccess.message: You track the creature to its location!

onFailure.message: You lose the trail.

challengeTemplates.name: Detect Deception
challengeTemplates.description: Determine if an NPC is lying

onSuccess.message: You sense the NPC is being deceptive!

onFailure.message: You believe the NPC is telling the truth.

challengeTemplates.name: Create Distraction
challengeTemplates.description: Create an improvised distraction to divert guards

onSuccess.message: Your clever distraction works perfectly, creating an opening!

onFailure.message: Your distraction attempt fails to fool the guards.

challengeTemplates.name: Perform Holy Ritual
challengeTemplates.description: Conduct a religious ceremony to consecrate an area

onSuccess.message: You successfully perform the ritual using your religious knowledge. The area is blessed!

onFailure.message: The ritual fails to take effect.

challengeTemplates.name: Narrow Ledge
challengeTemplates.description: Cross a narrow ledge without falling

onSuccess.message: You nimbly cross the narrow ledge!

onFailure.message: You lose your balance and fall!

challengeTemplates.name: Endure Harsh Environment
challengeTemplates.description: Push through extreme heat, cold, or exhaustion

onSuccess.message: You push through the harsh conditions!

onFailure.message: The conditions overwhelm you.
